name: Maintenance Request Report
query:
SELECT
    i.name AS "Request:Link/Issue:150",
    i.opening_date AS "Request Date:Date:110",
    i.subject AS "Subject:Data:220",
    i.custom_requester AS "Requester:Link/Employee:160",
    i.custom_facility_location AS "Facility Location:Link/Facility Location:200",
    fl.site AS "Site:Link/Site:140",
    fl.building AS "Building:Link/Building:140",
    i.custom_asset AS "Asset:Link/Asset:160",
    i.issue_type AS "Category:Link/Issue Type:140",
    i.priority AS "Priority:Data:100",
    i.custom_issue_status AS "Status:Data:110",
    i.custom_work_order AS "Work Order:Link/Facility Work Order:150",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.opening_date) AS "Age (Days):Int:90"
FROM `tabIssue` i
LEFT JOIN `tabFacility Location` fl
    ON fl.name = i.custom_facility_location
WHERE
    i.opening_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND i.company = %(company)s
    AND (
        %(status)s = 'All'
        OR i.custom_issue_status = %(status)s
    )
    AND (
        %(priority)s = 'All'
        OR i.priority = %(priority)s
    )
ORDER BY
    i.opening_date DESC,
    i.opening_time DESC
